scope: Five isolated presentation fixtures: actual Director opening boards for main episodes 1/11/16/20 with joined allies at authored EntryLevel, plus six-ally Lv25 training. Prior completion flags/levels exist only in new in-memory fixtures. No natural progression, story completion, rewards, AI/balance or full-campaign claim.
captures: 52 unedited ScreenCapture frames: each board idle at 0/90/180 degrees, legal Director movement in flight/at arrival, and a damage-pose-only fixture at 1280x720; two additional character focus frames; command and skill-list HUD at 1280x720 and 1024x768. Damage does not execute the resolver or change HP. No effect/skill-execution claim.
checks: Active model count, authored non-null sprites, finite ground/path placement, contact-shadow presence, supported materials, tile-pick round trips, rotation state/RNG invariance, actual legal movement completion, damage-fixture state invariance, visible UI glyph/button boundaries and exact requested resolution. Sprite AABB camera containment is telemetry only because transparent artwork padding is not visible geometry.
limitations: Automated pass is not visual approval. Inspect PNGs for palette harmony, terrain occlusion, visible foot anchoring, contact-shadow quality, character/background separation and UI readability. Four campaign opening boards and one training board are not all maps/poses/resolutions or performance coverage. User-storage hashing is top-level save/settings files; external wrapper may additionally hash the entire tree. No user files are restored.
